assets.title: Rolling Tray Table (Tattoo and Piercing Studio)
assets.summary: A rolling stainless tray table set out for a session: a castored frame under a lipped top with a row of coloured ink caps, a machine cradle, a wipe pack and a lower shelf.
assets.description: A rolling stainless tray table set out for a session: a castored frame under a lipped top with a row of coloured ink caps, a machine cradle, a wipe pack and a lower shelf. Overall 0.56 by 0.82 by 0.42 m (X by Y by Z). Metre units, +Y up, the side a client or an artist approaches from toward +Z, resting on y=0. The four castors spin as named nodes; the frame does not, because a trolley crossing a room is the whole model moving. The ink caps are empty cups: there is no liquid anywhere in this pack. Rigid node-transform clips: roll. No skinning. No collision or navigation data.

usage.modelViewer: <model-viewer src="https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/34518/v1/model.glb" alt="Rolling Tray Table (Tattoo and Piercing Studio)" camera-controls auto-rotate autoplay></model-viewer>
usage.blender:
# Blender 4.x: File > Import > glTF 2.0, or from the Python console after downloading the file.
import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/34518/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
# Clips arrive as actions; play them from the Dope Sheet > Action Editor.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)
var player := model.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false) as AnimationPlayer
player.play(player.get_animation_list()[0])

assets.title: Instrument Tray Set (Tattoo and Piercing Studio)
assets.summary: A laid out instrument tray: a stainless tray on a folded blue liner with slotted forceps, a pair of ring handled clamps, a sleeved needle, a marker and a gauze pack.
assets.description: A laid out instrument tray: a stainless tray on a folded blue liner with slotted forceps, a pair of ring handled clamps, a sleeved needle, a marker and a gauze pack. Overall 0.34 by 0.19 by 0.24 m (X by Y by Z). Metre units, +Y up, the side a client or an artist approaches from toward +Z, resting on y=0. A bench top model: it rests on y=0 so it sits straight on a tray table or a bench. The forceps are modelled open with real jaws and do not close, since a scissor linkage is two nodes turning about one pin and a rigid transform carries one. Static geometry; no rig, collision or navigation data.

assets.title: Barrier Film Roll (Tattoo and Piercing Studio)
assets.summary: A barrier film dispenser: a roll of blue protective film on a steel spindle in a wall bracket, with a torn leading sheet and a serrated cutter bar.
assets.description: A barrier film dispenser: a roll of blue protective film on a steel spindle in a wall bracket, with a torn leading sheet and a serrated cutter bar. Overall 0.36 by 0.29 by 0.17 m (X by Y by Z). Metre units, +Y up, the side a client or an artist approaches from toward +Z, resting on y=0. A wall piece resting on y=0, so a scene raises it above a bench. The roll does not turn: film unwinding is the sheet changing shape, which needs skinning and this library has none. Static geometry; no rig, collision or navigation data.
